name: Amazon S3 Standard
description: S3 STANDARD storage-class identity. Bucket region, account configuration, object history, capacity and rates require separate evidence; no EC2 hosting dependency.

provenance.notes: S3 STANDARD is the default object storage class; supports storage_type=object and service identity. Date is this mutable-document capture, not a service release. No region or maximum capacity invented. billing_class remains unknown until an exact account/rate scope is selected; not a free-service assertion.
